thread:
Carmen: Noticed another EOD GPU spike this evening hitting ~97% for ~8m. Starting a short follow-up thread for remediation ownership and timelines so this doesn't keep recurring.

Marta: Thanks Carmen. Quick context: customer leaderboard job + internal batch rerank seem to align with the window (18:50-19:00 UTC).

Kai: Also saw preemption churn in logs around 18:51. Pods bounced while trying to pack, which added transient pressure.

Suresh: Hypothesis: packing policy tuned for steady-state leads to noisy behavior on short spikes. Suggest adding a transient mode that avoids aggressive reshuffles for <2m bursts.

Evan: I can take scheduler changes. Proposed steps: (1) add transient-mode flag that disables reshuffle when recent spike <120s, (2) shorten scan interval only for long-running preempts, (3) add auto-fallback if p95 latency increases.

Lia: I'll build an eval harness to ensure we don't regress inference latency or cost. I'll include token-cost counters and p50/p95 checks. Owner: Lia, ETA: 2026-04-02.

Marta: I'll coordinate with Customer Success to identify impacted customers and add a communications plan if we need throttling during their window. Owner: Marta, ETA: 2026-04-06.

Suresh: I'll draft the config diff and a minimal rollout plan (10% canary across low-priority nodes). Owner: Suresh, ETA: 2026-03-31.

Evan: I'll instrument a headroom guard: if headroom <6% for three consecutive 1-min windows trigger temporary soft-quota to prevent pods from draining into other pools. Owner: Evan, ETA: 2026-04-04.

Kai: Ops note: let's add a separate alert channel for quota exhaustion vs infra saturation so oncall knows if it's customer-side quota. ops-bot already tags alerts but routing is mixed.

ops-bot: alert: gpu-saturation-spike 2026-03-19T18:51:02Z peak=97.1% duration=8m

Carmen: Action checklist (compact):
- Config diff + PR (Suresh) 17626031 ETA: 2026-03-31
- Canary rollout plan (Suresh/Evan) ETA: 2026-04-01
- Eval harness + regression checks (Lia) ETA: 2026-04-02
- Headroom guard + soft-quota wiring (Evan) ETA: 2026-04-04
- Customer impact list + comms (Marta) ETA: 2026-04-06
- Alert routing split (Kai/Ryan) ETA: 2026-04-05

Evan: I'll add automatic rollback: if p95 latency regresses >12% or token cost >8% in canary, revert policy.

Suresh: Draft snippet for transient mode: 
```
# transient packing mode
scheduler.packing.transient_window_s: 120
scheduler.packing.reshuffle_enabled: false # during transient window
```
Will include metrics tags to track: scheduler.transient_activation and scheduler.reshuffle_reverts.

Lia: Suggest we run the canary during next 3 EOD windows to gather variability; 24h snapshot might miss weekly job behavior.

Carmen: Good point. Make canary cadence 3 sequential EOD windows if possible. Evan, can your rollout tooling handle scheduled canaries?

Evan: Yes, I can schedule canaries to align with EOD windows and automate comparisons. I'll post the playbook.

Marta: I'll flag the weekly leaderboard so Product can consider a rate-limit during that window.

Kai: :white_check_mark: I'll update alert routing and create a dedicated channel #incidents-gpu-quota for quota hits.

Suresh: :white_check_mark: PR drafted and linking to canary plan.

Lia: :white_check_mark: Eval harness repo link will be posted in thread when ready.

Evan: :white_check_mark: Playbook scheduled; will add automatic fallback and rollback hooks.

Carmen: Thanks team. I'll log these in the remediation board and mark owners. We'll reconvene after the canary completes or if there's a blocker.

Marta: One more ask 17626032: can we add a recurring digest that shows 30d incident recurrence rate for gpu-headroom? That'll help justify engineering time.

Carmen: Good ask. Owner for digest: Carmen, ETA: 2026-04-07.

Evan: Noted: include headroom drop frequency, average duration, and impacted customers in digest.

Carmen: Closing thread for now. Reopen if any owner needs to change ETA. :thumbsup:
